verdict:
One hundred and forty some repos and the intern still names things like a toddler labels a junk drawer. The summaries tell the real story: this fleet is a cloning plant with a filing problem. There are two sound visualizers that are the same idea twice (scope-listener and phasewell-scope, both comparing a song to the mic), a whole synth shelf (synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand, looper) that could be one instrument with a tab bar, three restaurant survey tools standing in a line like a committee that never votes (RTSS, ghost-kitchen-builder, restack), a pair of tower games, the topo-war litter, two pixel towns, and two skwiggle backends. Then you built a new agent repo every day this week, each with its own sandbox, vault, and notes repo, which is a bureaucracy built by one guy for the benefit of nobody. The names x, rat, androids, and xxxx are a campaign slogan for giving up.

Merge these: scope-listener and phasewell-scope into one scope with a mode switch. synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand, and looper into one instrument app. RTSS, ghost-kitchen-builder, and restack into one restaurant survey app, with rie-api as its single backend. topo-wars, topo-war, and topo-wars-server into one game with a server folder. topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns into one repo. tower-builder and tower2 into one app with a version switch. field-twin, field-twin-viridian, and field-twin-violet-api into one twin with a theme setting. termbeat, coffeekit, and bitfield-synth into one audio visualizer. skwiggle-v105, skwiggle-mint-pin, and skwiggle-backend into one repo. signal-snapshot and signal-snapshot-backend, hackercons-roulette and its api, and threat-poller, threat-dash, and threat-atlas-v3 each into one repo. blue-agent and blue-agent-sandbox, plus doctrine-duel-qx and its sandbox, each into one repo.

Kill or finish these: xxxx, x, rat, androids, pancake-orange, note-note-note, final-vector, and drivethru-sim, which is empty and untouched since April. Judge these by their live links before you delete anything, because some apps were pushed from the phone and the repo can look dead while the site is fine. Finish forkmill-zx and fogwarren-vx, which have no summary at all.

Keep and polish these: mill-ionaire, the one thing here with real depth and actual tests, even if you keep loosening them. 2026-10-23-orange-smash, once you stop piling features into one index.html. mission-operator, datacenter-osint, and mind-globe, which are one of a kind. kat-chat, nota-city, and the pajamastan family. The access-terminal apps stay separate on purpose, so leave them alone.
